definitions.ask: Should a managed project's declared builtin plans or beads sidecar that omits auto_sync default to auto_sync true?
definitions.why: Every other path that creates these entries already enables auto_sync

choices.label: Managed builtin plans/beads omitting auto_sync get true, like injected defaults; false still wins
Keep the false default; set auto_sync true on bob-cli's plans and beads in its sase.yml
No backstop for bob-cli; bead edits from other machines stay unseen there until a manual pull
